FLY/READ — research text classifier

Recorded anatomy and connectivity: MaleCNS v1.0. FlyEM at HHMI Janelia,
University of Cambridge, MRC Laboratory of Molecular Biology, and Google Research.
Data license: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0
https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/
https://male-cns.janelia.org/download/

499-cell circuit selection and published geometry: Nathan Roll / Oruk,
https://oruk.ai/research/we-taught-a-fruit-fly-to-read-human-emotion
Original binary SHA-256:
f6750dcd1312b8794480130571095ad097ccb93b17fcefe2578f1811bfdbe9b8
Only the published recurrent connectivity is used from the speech model.
Its audio projection, trained speech readout, labels and audio are not used.
Recurrent weights retained unchanged; neuron indices remain in the release order.
The public export does not provide original MaleCNS body IDs. Local indices
0..498 must never be described as biological dataset identifiers.
Anatomy: every eighth released line segment per neuron retained for drawing;
this further sampling has no effect on computation. All 499 cells are retained.

New adaptation: English text tokenization, label-free TF-IDF/LSA embeddings,
fixed random projection, a newly fitted text readout, and browser inference.
The dynamic leak coefficient for text is 0.35. Original recurrent spectral
scaling (0.9) and signs are retained. These are simplified simulated units,
not validated physiological dynamics or a living fly learning English.

Text dataset: Saravia et al. (2018), CARER: Contextualized Affect
Representations for Emotion Recognition, distributed by DAIR.AI.
https://aclanthology.org/D18-1404/
https://huggingface.co/datasets/dair-ai/emotion
Revision: cab853a1dbdf4c42c2b3ef2173804746df8825fe
Dataset card limits use to educational and research purposes.
Raw training, validation, and test sentences are not distributed in this app.
Labels are distant/noisy annotations; this is not a clinical or mental-state test.

Inspiration for local simulation controls: Xenova / Neural Canvas
https://huggingface.co/spaces/Xenova/fruit-fly-simulation
No Xenova source code or body assets are bundled here.

See report.json for reproducible split counts, source hashes, measured results,
control models, confusion matrices, and limitations. Only one circuit and seed
were used. Scores are raw ridge outputs, not calibrated probabilities.
